title: Preferred Employer Credit for a Month Whose Rent Went Late — Worked Cases (Apartment Home Lease)
content:
On an Apartment Home Lease, when the period's rent went late the preferred employer discount credit is taken in part:

- a period that carries an initial late fee line while no other billing period of the lease carries one in the last 12 months is credited three quarters (0.75) of the discount, rounded down to the cent;
- a period that carries an initial late fee line while another billing period carries one in the last 12 months is credited half (0.5) of the discount, rounded half up to the cent;
- a period that carries no initial late fee line is credited the whole discount.

"The last 12 months" means initial late fee lines dated after the same day of the month twelve months before the handling date. "The discount" is the preferred employer discount figured for the period before this rule is applied.

## Decision grid

| Initial late fee line on the period credited | Initial late fee line on another billing period, dated in the last 12 months | Share credited | Rounding |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | three quarters (75%) | down to the cent |
| Yes | Yes | half (50%) | half up to the cent |
| No | either | the whole discount | — |

## Worked cases (hypothetical discounts)

| Discount for the period | Situation | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| $107.50 | first late period in 12 months | 75% is $80.625, rounded down: **$80.62** |
| $107.50 | another late period in 12 months | 50% is $53.75: **$53.75** |
| $61.73 | first late period in 12 months | 75% is $46.2975, rounded down: **$46.29** |
| $61.73 | another late period in 12 months | 50% is $30.865, rounded half up: **$30.87** |
| $61.73 | no initial late fee line on the period | **$61.73** |

**Window boundary (hypothetical).** Handling date 20 May 2026: another period's initial late fee line dated 21 May 2025 falls in the last 12 months; one dated 20 May 2025 does not.
